# PerkStack Documentation

> Complete documentation for PerkStack, the loyalty points and product reviews platform for Shopify merchants. These docs cover setup, loyalty programs, reviews, storefront widgets, integrations, billing, and troubleshooting.

## Getting Started

- [First-Time Setup](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/getting-started/first-time-config): The four-step PerkStack setup wizard — Welcome, Points, Branding, and Launch — gets your loyalty program live in about two minutes. Everything is changeable later.
- [Going Live on Your Store](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/getting-started/going-live): Turn PerkStack on in your storefront: use the Dashboard Theme Setup checklist to enable the loyalty launcher, add review blocks, and add customer-page blocks.
- [How It Works](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/getting-started/how-it-works): The PerkStack loyalty and reviews flywheel: customers earn points on purchases, reviews, and referrals, redeem them for rewards, and come back to buy again.
- [Installing PerkStack](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/getting-started/installation): Install PerkStack: Loyalty & Reviews from the Shopify App Store in a couple of minutes — no separate account, and a short setup wizard opens automatically.
- [Introduction](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/getting-started/introduction): PerkStack: Loyalty & Reviews brings a points program, product reviews, and referrals together in one Shopify app — turning one-time buyers into repeat customers.
- [Connecting Your Store](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/getting-started/shopify-setup): Your first look inside PerkStack: how the app sits in your Shopify admin, the left-nav map, and what to have ready before you set up your program.

## Dashboard

- [Analytics](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/dashboard/analytics): PerkStack Analytics: six tabs covering members, points, rewards, reviews, and referrals, with revenue attribution, plan-based history windows, and a weekly digest.
- [Theme Setup & Status](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/dashboard/extension-status): The Theme Setup checklist shows which PerkStack blocks are live on your store, grouped into Loyalty, Reviews, and Admin pages, so you can confirm you are fully set up.
- [Overview](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/dashboard/overview): The PerkStack Dashboard is your at-a-glance home: points issued and redeemed, a 30-day trend, your loyalty on/off status, and the Theme Setup checklist.

## Loyalty Program

- [Birthday Rewards](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/loyalty/birthday-rewards): Surprise customers with bonus loyalty points on their birthday to build a personal connection and bring them back each year.
- [Points Campaigns & Boosts](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/loyalty/campaigns): Run time-boxed points multipliers in PerkStack so customers earn 2x or more during a scheduled window. Set up, schedule, and track boosts.
- [Ways to Earn](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/loyalty/earn-rules): The seven actions that award loyalty points in PerkStack, their default point values, which plan unlocks each, and how to configure them.
- [Overview](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/loyalty/overview): How the PerkStack loyalty program fits together: ways to earn points, rewards to redeem, VIP tiers, referrals, and points campaigns.
- [How Points Work](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/loyalty/points-system): How a customer's points balance and activity history work in PerkStack, plus optional points expiry and points delay.
- [Referrals](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/loyalty/referrals): Turn happy customers into advocates: give friends a discount on their first order and reward both sides with points.
- [Rewards Catalog](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/loyalty/rewards): The seven reward types customers can redeem loyalty points for, which plan unlocks each, point costs, tier restrictions, redemption limits, and what shoppers see.
- [Social Sharing](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/loyalty/social-sharing): Reward customers with loyalty points for sharing your products on social media, turning shoppers into brand advocates.
- [VIP Tiers](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/loyalty/vip-tiers): Reward your best customers with a points multiplier and tier-exclusive rewards as they earn more over time.

## Product Reviews

- [Importing Reviews](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/reviews/importing): Bring your existing reviews from Judge.me or Loox into PerkStack with a one-time CSV import, so you keep the social proof you've built.
- [Moderation](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/reviews/moderation): Approve, reply to, and feature customer reviews from your Shopify admin, and set auto-approval rules so clean reviews publish instantly.
- [Overview](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/reviews/overview): Collect product reviews on your Shopify store: how the review form works, submission rules, auto-approval, and how reviews earn loyalty points.
- [Photo Reviews](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/reviews/photo-reviews): Let customers attach photos to their reviews for stronger, higher-converting social proof. Available on Essential and above.
- [Review Request Emails](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/reviews/review-requests): Automatically email customers to review what they bought after an order ships, with an optional reminder. Control the timing and wording.
- [SEO & Rich Snippets](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/reviews/seo): Show your product star ratings in Google search results. Add the Review SEO block to your product pages — no settings, no code.

## Integrations

- [AI Agent Access](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/integrations/agent-access): Let an AI assistant like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor run your loyalty and reviews program for you. Generate a secure access token and connect your assistant in a few clicks.
- [Judge.me Sync](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/integrations/judgeme): Keep your reviews in sync with Judge.me in both directions. Connect once and existing reviews import, new PerkStack reviews push to Judge.me, and replies and moderation stay matched on both sides.
- [Shopify Flow](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/integrations/shopify-flow): Automate your loyalty and reviews program with Shopify Flow. Trigger workflows when reviews come in, and let Flow run PerkStack actions like approving reviews or launching a points boost.

## Storefront Widgets

- [Checkout Rewards](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/checkout-widget): Let signed-in shoppers see their points balance and redeem an affordable reward right inside the Shopify checkout, with the discount applied to their order automatically.
- [Review Collection Stars](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/collection-stars): Add star ratings to product cards on your collection and listing pages so shoppers can compare products by rating before they click through.
- [Loyalty Studio](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/customer-account): Give members a full loyalty dashboard inside their Shopify account — balance, tier progress, rewards, ways to earn, referrals, and activity, all in one place.
- [Loyalty Launcher](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/loyalty-launcher): Add a floating rewards button to your storefront so shoppers can check their points, tier, and rewards from any page.
- [Loyalty Page](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/loyalty-page): Embed a full rewards dashboard on a dedicated storefront page so customers can see their points, tier, ways to earn, and history in one place.
- [Overview](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/overview): The storefront widgets and blocks that bring your PerkStack loyalty program and reviews to your Shopify store, checkout, and customer account.
- [Review Carousel](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/review-carousel): Add a rotating carousel of your top and most recent reviews to the homepage for social proof, with each review linking to its product.
- [Review Display](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/review-display): Show customer reviews on your product pages with a rating summary, photos, verified badges, and sortable review list or grid.
- [Review Form](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/review-form): Add a 'Write a review' form to your product pages so customers can rate, review, and upload photos, with an optional points incentive.
- [Review Star Badge](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/star-badge): Show a compact star rating and review count near your product title so shoppers see social proof at a glance and can jump straight to the reviews.

## Customers

- [Customer Page Blocks](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/customers/admin-blocks): Add PerkStack blocks to Shopify's own customer page so your team can view balances, adjust points, change tiers, redeem rewards, and read reviews without leaving Shopify.
- [Customer Detail](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/customers/detail): See a customer's full loyalty profile — balance, spend, tier progress, recent activity, reviews, and pending points — and use manual controls to adjust points or grant a reward.
- [Freeze & Unfreeze](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/customers/freeze): Pause a single customer's ability to earn and redeem loyalty points without deleting them or their balance — fully reversible whenever you're ready.
- [Customer Management](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/customers/management): Search, browse, and manage every member of your loyalty program from one list, with quick actions to adjust points, freeze accounts, and review history.
- [Tier Overrides](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/customers/tier-overrides): Pin a customer to a chosen VIP tier regardless of their lifetime points, and reset them back to automatic when you're done.

## Settings

- [Plans & Billing](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/settings/billing): PerkStack pricing — Free, Essential ($29/mo), Growth ($99/mo), and Studio ($299/mo). Order and email caps, free trials, and how to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel through Shopify.
- [Email & Notifications](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/settings/email): Set the sender name and reply-to address on your loyalty and review emails, manage the weekly digest, remove PerkStack branding, and track monthly email usage.
- [General](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/settings/general): Name your points, set an optional expiry, delay earned points to cover refunds, and add your store logo — the core settings for your loyalty program.
- [Review Settings](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/settings/review-settings): One place for your review rules — auto-approve threshold, blacklisted words, verified-purchase, reviewer names, request and reminder timing, photos, and email copy.
- [Trigger Button](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/settings/trigger-button): Style the floating rewards button shoppers tap to open your loyalty launcher — its text, colors, icon, shape, and corner rounding, with a live preview.
- [Widget Customization](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/settings/widget-customization): Design your loyalty launcher and loyalty page to match your brand — accent color, theme, fonts, shape, card style, copy, hero image, and logo, with a live preview.

## Troubleshooting

- [Common Issues](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/troubleshooting/common-issues): Quick fixes for the things merchants hit most: storefront blocks not showing, points not awarding, reviews or emails missing, and features that appear locked.
- [FAQ](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/troubleshooting/faq): Answers to the questions merchants ask most about PerkStack — plans and pricing, trials, order caps, downgrades, branding, and how points and reviews behave.
- [Status Reference](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/troubleshooting/status-reference): A plain-language glossary of the statuses you see across PerkStack — for reviews, redemptions, referrals, customers, and points activity — and what each one means for you.

## More

- [PerkStack Website](https://perk-stack.com): Product site and Shopify app listing.
- [PerkStack Blog](https://blog.perk-stack.com): Guides, updates, and merchant tips.
